5 friends — Anya, Divya, Chetan, Esha, and Bilal — sit around a circular table, facing the center. Study the clues below and answer the questions that follow.

- There are exactly 2 people between Divya and Bilal, going clockwise from Divya.
- There are exactly 1 people between Esha and Anya, going clockwise from Esha.
- There are exactly 2 people between Bilal and Chetan, going clockwise from Bilal.
